highlights.excerpt: Distillation is good and healthy in AI. It's one of the few things limiting extreme concentration of power, capabilities and wealth (and very similar to how AI companies got successful distilling the web). Great to see @Google promoting it! https://t.co/LDMuX2upMA
highlights.excerpt_zh: 蒸馏对 AI 是一件好事，也是健康的。它是少数能限制权力、能力与财富极度集中的机制之一（这和 AI 公司靠蒸馏互联网获得成功非常相似）。很高兴看到 @Google 在推广它！ https://t.co/LDMuX2upMA

highlights.excerpt:
Starting today, we're offering free Kimi API credits to support scientific research worldwide.

Selected teams will receive free Kimi API credits, access to our latest models, and opportunities for long-term collaboration.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 即日起，我们向全球科研提供免费的 Kimi API 额度。入选团队将获得免费 API 额度、最新模型使用权，以及长期合作机会。该计划延续我们对开权模型的承诺，让前沿 AI 对研究者更加可及。

highlights.excerpt: I regret to inform you that a lot of the small problems, stresses, and anxieties of life disappear when you start taking action. It’s much harder for those things to catch a body in motion. The answers you seek are found in the relentless action you avoid.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 很遗憾地告诉你：生活中许多小问题、压力和焦虑，会在你开始行动之后消失。这些东西很难追上一个在动的人。你要找的答案，就藏在你一直回避的持续行动里。
highlights.name: Sahil Bloom
highlights.text_zh: Sahil Bloom 说，许多焦虑会在开始行动后消失，答案往往藏在被回避的行动里。

highlights.excerpt:
New trend I'm observing:

1. Startup raises venture capital
2. Uses venture dollars to become creator 
3. Startup fails
4. Fall back on becoming a full-time creator and makes $500k-$5M/year as creator
5. Incubates other products bootstrapped
6. Never raises VC again
highlights.excerpt_zh:
我观察到一个新趋势：

1. 创企融到风险投资
2. 用风投的钱去做创作者
3. 创企失败
4. 退回成为全职创作者，一年赚 50 万到 500 万美元
5. 再自举孵化其他产品
6. 从此不再融资
highlights.name: GREG ISENBERG
highlights.text_zh: Greg 观察到一种新路径：创企融资做内容，失败后转为全职创作者，再反向孵化产品、不再融资。

highlights.excerpt: There's something happening with post-training! People are starting to realize you can post-train open-source model to frontier on your tasks and constraints at a fraction of the cost of generalist black-box APIs. Let's go! https://t.co/yRcOlWCSpo
highlights.excerpt_zh: 后训练正在发生一些事！人们开始意识到，可以把开源模型后训练到在自己的任务和约束上达到前沿水平，成本只是通用黑盒 API 的一小部分。冲！ https://t.co/yRcOlWCSpo
highlights.name: clem 🤗
highlights.text_zh: Clem 称，针对自身任务做开源模型后训练，成本远低于通用黑盒 API，却能达到前沿水平。
